title: RFI Review of Medical Tort Claims
agency: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL PRISON SYSTEM / BUREAU OF PRISONS > NATIONAL ACQUISITIONS - CO

files.name: SOW REVIEW AND ANALYSIS OF MEDICAL MALPRACTICE ADMINISTRATIVE TORT CLAIMS.pdf

description:
The Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP) requires independent, professional medical review and analysis services in support of administrative tort claims alleging medical negligence or malpractice associated with medical care provided to individuals in BOP custody.  The contractor shall provice qualified medical specialist to conduct objective evaluations of medical records, assess the applicable standards of care, identify potential deviations from those standards, evaluate medical causation and resulting injuries, and prepare comprehensive written medical opinions. Services shall be preformed on an as needed basis in response to individual case assignments issued by authorized Government personnel.  

 Vendors should carefully review the SOW before submitting a response. The Government is seeking capability information from firms that can directly perform and support the full scope of services. Responses that do not address the firm's ability to meet the requirements outlined in the SOW may be considered less useful for market research purposes.  

  THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS OR QUOTATIONS.  

 This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. The Government is conducting market research to identify qualified contractors capable of providing review of medical tort claims. 

 The purpose of this notice is to determine the availability of capable small business concerns, including socioeconomic small business categories, and to assist the Government in developing an appropriate acquisition strategy and potential set-aside determination. 

 Responses to this notice are voluntary and shall not be considered offers. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this Sources Sought Notice and will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparing or submitting a response. 

   Interested vendors are requested to provide:   

 
	 Company name and address 
	 UEI number 
	 Business size and socioeconomic status 
	 Relevant NAICS code(s) 
	 SAM.gov registration status 
	 Description of experience reviewing medical tort claims 
	 Any recommended contract structure or acquisition considerations 
 

 The Government may use information received in response to this notice for acquisition planning purposes only. Participation in this market research effort is not a prerequisite for participation in any future solicitation.
